title: Cutaneous Vasculitis / Purpura Algorithm
subtitle: Palpable purpura, biopsy timing, and systemic screen

steps.prompt: Is purpura palpable or retiform, or are there ulcers/necrosis?
Lesional biopsy plus baseline systemic screen
steps.detail: Obtain appropriate lesional biopsies: active purpura for H&E and a fresh early lesion for DIF, using the laboratory protocol. Assess blood pressure, urinalysis, renal function and systemic features even when symptoms appear skin-limited.

steps.prompt: Systemic vasculitis workup: UA, creatinine, CBC, CMP, complements, hepatitis, ANCA as indicated
Skin-limited leukocytoclastic vasculitis: trigger search and supportive/treatment pathway
steps.detail: Only call disease skin-limited after an appropriate systemic assessment; repeat assessment if symptoms or urine/renal findings evolve. Review triggers and tailor supportive or anti-inflammatory treatment.

citations.quote: StatPearls Leukocytoclastic Vasculitis review summarizes palpable purpura evaluation, biopsy, DIF, and systemic workup.
Algorithmic cutaneous vasculitis review discusses biopsy timing, direct immunofluorescence, and systemic assessment.
